brief:
# SEAM-FIX — close the composition-root seam that neither fleet leg owned

You are working on the MERGED result of a two-leg fleet run. Both legs delivered correct work and the tree is five gate legs green. There is exactly ONE defect, it is precisely located, and closing it is the whole job. Do not refactor, do not improve neighbouring code, do not widen scope.

## The defect, measured

A fleet leg (L1) built a working describe-live API client. Another leg (L2) built the live-step UI surface. Neither leg owned the WIRE BETWEEN THEM, so it was never made.

At `apps/aion-ops-console/src/features/workflow-detail/swimlane/WorkflowDetailView.tsx`:
- line 14 carries the comment `// FLEET-SEAM(L1): replaced at merge with createConfiguredLiveStepReader({ namespace })`
- lines 15-18 define `preMergeLiveStepReader`, a placeholder whose only behaviour is to THROW `'FLEET-SEAM(L1) was not replaced: no live-step API reader is configured'`
- line 84 passes `reader={preMergeLiveStepReader}` into `<LiveStepCard>`

L2 expected the merge to substitute the real reader. **The merge is mechanical — it merges branches, it does not perform semantic substitutions.** So the placeholder shipped.

The real reader already exists and is complete: `createConfiguredLiveStepReader` is exported from `apps/aion-ops-console/src/lib/config/clients.ts` and returns a `DescribeLiveReadClient` from `apps/aion-ops-console/src/lib/api/describe-live-read.ts`, whose endpoint constant is `DESCRIBE_LIVE_ENDPOINT = '/workflows/describe-live'` at line 32.

**Consequence, and it is why this matters more than a missing import:** nothing anywhere imports `lib/config/clients` (verify this yourself with a grep before you start — it is the crux). So `createConfiguredLiveStepReader` is unreachable from the entry point, vite tree-shakes it out, and the string `/workflows/describe-live` never reaches the shipped bundle at all. Every source-level check passes — typecheck, biome, 1037 unit tests — because the placeholder is type-correct and only fails at runtime.

## Requirements

R1. **Wire the real reader at the composition root.** `WorkflowDetailView` must obtain its `LiveStepReader` from `createConfiguredLiveStepReader`, passing the namespace the view already has in scope. Delete `preMergeLiveStepReader` and the FLEET-SEAM comment — a placeholder left beside working code is an invitation to wire the wrong one.

R2. **Preserve L2's injection seam.** `LiveStepCard` takes `reader` as a prop and its tests inject a fake. That is the house pattern (see `useChildren.ts` and `legs.test.tsx`) and it must survive: the component stays injectable, and it is the VIEW that supplies the configured reader by default. Do not make the component construct its own client.

R3. **Prove the wire at the artefact, not the source.** After your change, run `cargo xtask build-ops-console` from the repo root to regenerate the committed embed, then grep every `*.js` chunk under `crates/aion-server/ops-console-embed/assets/` for `workflows/describe-live` and show a NON-ZERO count. Report the count and the canary (`workflow`, which should be in the hundreds). A source-level claim that it is wired is not acceptance here — the entire defect is that source-level checks all passed.

R4. **Do not break the neighbours.** `workflows/children` (currently 7), `workflows/describe` (3), `workflows/history` (6), `workflows/transcripts` (5) and `workflows/list` (1) must all remain non-zero in the rebuilt bundle.

R5. **Type errors are yours to fix, scope creep is not.** If wiring the real reader surfaces a type mismatch between L1's client shape and L2's port type, fix it at the seam — that mismatch IS the defect, not a separate task. If it turns out to require changes beyond these two files plus the port type, STOP and report rather than widening.

## Hard constraints

Run `bun install` in `apps/aion-ops-console` before any typecheck or test — the tree may not have node_modules. Worktree only; NEVER push. Commit at truthful points as you go. No new dotfolders, no daemons, no CARGO_TARGET_DIR override. The embed under `crates/aion-server/ops-console-embed/` is GENERATED — regenerate it with the xtask, never hand-edit an asset; a hand-edited asset is an automatic reject.

## Done means

R3's non-zero describe-live count in the rebuilt bundle with its canary, R4's five neighbours still non-zero, the placeholder gone, and the standing gates green. State plainly anything you did not do.
